description.value: Bufala Kerrisdale is an award-winning independent Neapolitan pizzeria described by Vancouver Magazine as 'the beating heart of the Kerrisdale food scene,' earning multiple Best Pizzeria and Best West Side Restaurant honours. Fresh, scratch-made pizzas are fired in an 800-degree stone oven alongside Italian-inspired small plates, cocktails, and craft beers. It is the original location of a three-location Vancouver restaurant group, with walk-ins always welcome.
